ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: INTRO TO B&W PHOTOGRAPHY: Introduction to the processes of black and white photography, including camera use, film exposure and processing, and enlarged printing. For Unit One and other Living/Learning Community students only or by permission of the instructor. Art and Design minors who wish to take this class should contact the A+D minor advisor Guen Montgomery (montgo@illinois.edu). This is a second half session course. The first meeting is Tuesday, March 24, 2020.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to LEADS LLC, Global Crossroads, Honors LLC, Health Professions Lv Lrn Comm, Intersections, Innovations LLC, Sustainability LLC, Unit One, Weston Explorer Program, or Women in Math/Science/Engr Prg students.
